config.script:
import urllib
	url = '%s/data/perspective/client/%s/%s' % (self.session.props.gateway.address, system.project.getProjectName(), urllib.quote(self.view.custom.project, ''))
	if self.view.custom.key and self.view.custom.key != 'report:overview':
		url += '/' + urllib.quote(self.view.custom.key, '')
	system.perspective.openPopup('itm-link', 'LinkPopup', params={'url': url}, title='Link to this page', modal=True, showCloseIcon=True,
		draggable=False, resizable=False, viewportBound=True)

key = self.view.custom.key
	if key:
		cats = [k for k in self.view.custom.show if self.view.custom.show[k]]
		md = inspector.source.markdown(self.view.custom.project, key, self.view.custom.follow, cats)
		name = (self.view.custom.project + '-' + (key.partition(':')[2].strip('/').replace('/', '-').replace('@', '') or 'home'))
		system.perspective.download(name + '.md', md, 'text/markdown')
self.view.custom.show = dict((k, True) for k in ['issue', 'risk', 'api', 'nq', 'sql', 'script', 'block', 'nav', 'popup', 'msg', 'embed', 'tag', 'change'])
self.view.custom.show = dict((k, False) for k in ['issue', 'risk', 'api', 'nq', 'sql', 'script', 'block', 'nav', 'popup', 'msg', 'embed', 'tag', 'change'])
